body:
This PR adds ClimaTimeSteppers v1 to the compat so that nightly AMIP can run.

Note that compat for nightly AMIP will not instantiate due to CloudMicrophysics. It will be able to instantiate when https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaAtmos.jl/pull/4825 is merged.
title: Add ClimaTimeSteppers v1 to compat
